title: SynAmp business and development roadmap — simple install, 2027 launch
capacity: 20–25 owner hours/week · one-time purchase · simple install before testers (changed Oct 13)

scenarios.label: Working plan · Apr 6, 2027
scenarios.detail: Mac and Windows app · paid early access · all gates required
scenarios.note: Needs wave 1 (Mac) activated by early February so four-week return is measured by mid-March.

scenarios.label: Stretch · Mar 16, 2027
scenarios.note: Only if the Mac app and wave 1 land early and Windows follows after.

scenarios.label: Fallback · May 4, 2027
scenarios.detail: Extra time for Windows or the four-week check
scenarios.note: If any gate is open on Apr 6.

tasks.label: Any chip · lighter listening
tasks.detail: Intel/AMD and ARM release images; the listener runs on ONNX Runtime instead of PyTorch.

tasks.label: SynAmp for Mac, inside
tasks.detail: One app with the server, Navidrome, ffmpeg and the listener; music from a folder or a NAS share.

tasks.label: First run · menu bar · updates · signing
tasks.detail: Where's your music, plain progress, first playlist the same day; start at login; automatic updates; notarized.
tasks.note: Needs an Apple Developer account by Nov 30.

tasks.label: SynAmp for Windows
tasks.detail: Same app on Windows; paths and file moves tested.

tasks.label: Measure → repair (NAS pilot)
tasks.detail: Frozen suite; owner scores; 3–5 technical friends on the NAS install.
tasks.note: Frozen suite and challenge-30 baseline captured; needs owner listening scores.

tasks.label: Ten-library proof · workday listening
tasks.detail: Two raters per library across waves 1–2; continuous mixes, corrections, restart.

tasks.label: Required checks · restore · upgrade
tasks.detail: Release checks pass on GitHub; backup/restore and update/roll-back rehearsed for the app too.
tasks.note: Six release-check jobs pass on main; making them required is an owner setting.

tasks.label: Freeze scope · close blockers
tasks.detail: No open serious bugs on supported paths before paid release.

tasks.label: Watched first runs (non-technical)
tasks.detail: Three to five people watched installing the app; fix what trips them.

tasks.label: Wave 1 · Mac · ten people
tasks.detail: At least half not technical; in-app Send feedback; 72-hour and four-week check-ins.
tasks.note: Send feedback is built; SUPPORT_EMAIL still to set.

tasks.label: Wave 2 · Mac + Windows
tasks.detail: At least five strangers; every attempt counted.

tasks.label: Waitlist · app story · clips
tasks.detail: Site copy for the download-and-open story; consent opt-in; real clips from the waves.

tasks.label: Name · licences · external services
tasks.detail: Last.fm, LRCLIB, PANNs weights (now shipped inside the app), name search.
tasks.note: Emails not sent yet; replies take weeks. Send by Oct 19.

tasks.label: Offer test → sandbox checkout
tasks.detail: $39/$49 hypothesis retested with waves; test purchase and refund.

tasks.label: Paid cohort → May review
tasks.detail: Ten paying customers, refunds reported, support time measured.

gates.label: Any chip
gates.detail: Both image types from one tag; ONNX listener matches PyTorch on real songs; owner NAS on the current build.

gates.label: Mac app inside
gates.detail: Installs and plays on the owner's Mac and one other Mac, from a folder and a NAS share.

gates.label: First run
gates.detail: Three watched first runs by non-technical people reach a playlist without help; signed and notarized.

gates.label: Wave 1
gates.detail: ≥9/10 install without live help, ≥half non-technical; ≥60% useful playlist within 72 h.

gates.label: Wave 2
gates.detail: Same bar on Mac and Windows; ≥5 strangers; every attempt counted.

gates.label: Paid EA
gates.detail: Four-week return ≥50% with n≥10; rights; checkout; tested restore and updates; no open S1/S2.

gates.label: Review
gates.detail: Scorecard: activation, four-week return, paying customers, support hours.

verdict.summary: Plan changed Oct 13: SynAmp becomes one app you download and open before the main test waves. Paid early access moves to Apr 6, 2027 (stretch Mar 16, fallback May 4). First steps (any chip, lighter listening) started.
